description: For most people, a home is their largest purchase and biggest asset. Walking through an empty house can be uninspiring and overwhelming for buyers. Home staging brings the imagination and insight they need to become excited about a property. Rolf Broms and Associates is the premiere home staging firm. Our interior designer utilizes existing furniture, artwork, rugs, lighting, plants and accessories to transform the home into something luxurious and lived in. Our homes sell quickly and for the highest prices in the their neighborhoods.
